trust_decision.summary: Entity/statistic/device/state names (attacker-influenced via integrations or registry) must be treated as text, not HTML, when echarts tooltip formatters build HTML strings; at the pinned commit this is decided ad hoc per formatter (some call filterXSS, some do not) plus a series-name filterXSS in ha-chart-base that the minmax line path skips; the fix moves it to ha-chart-base, which renders every function formatter's Lit template into a DOM node.
